feliz.en: a genuine warm smile, happy bright eyes

rindo.en: laughing out loud, eyes squinting, mouth wide open in laughter

triste.en: sad, downcast eyes, slight frown, melancholic and tired

chorando.en: crying hard, tears streaming down the cheeks, red swollen watery eyes, trembling lips

irritado.en: annoyed and irritated, furrowed brow, tight pressed lips

furioso.en: furious and enraged, shouting, teeth showing, veins on the forehead, intense glare

desconfiado.en: suspicious, narrowed eyes, sideways glance, skeptical

assustado.en: terrified, wide open eyes, raised eyebrows, mouth slightly open, pale skin

nervoso.en: nervous and anxious, biting the lip, light sweat, eyes darting

sarcastico.en: sarcastic smirk, one eyebrow raised, mocking look

ameacador.en: menacing, cold dead stare, faint sinister smile, head slightly tilted down

carinhoso.en: tender and affectionate, soft eyes, gentle smile

surpreso.en: shocked and surprised, eyebrows raised high, mouth open

envergonhado.en: embarrassed, blushing cheeks, looking away, awkward smile
